title: MemReward: Graph-Based Experience Memory for LLM Reward Prediction with Limited Labels
abstract: arXiv:2603.19310v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning improves large language model (LLM) reasoning using reward signals on sampled rollouts. When reward labels are available for only a subset of rollouts, restricting policy updates to that subset leaves the remaining rollouts unused for policy optimization. Semi-supervised learning propagates labels from labeled to unlabeled samples, but existing methods either diffuse labels with fixed similarity weights or treat each sample independently, ignoring the relations among queries, thinking processes, and answers. We propose MemReward, a graph-based experience memory that propagates rewards to unlabeled rollouts during online policy optimization. MemReward stores queries and the rollouts (thinking processes and final answers) of an initial LLM policy as nodes of a heterogeneous graph connected by similarity and structural edges, and warms up a GNN on labeled rollouts to propagate rewards over t

translated_title: MemReward：基于图的经验记忆用于有限标签下的LLM奖励预测
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）微调通过在采样轨迹上利用奖励信号来提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。当只有部分轨迹拥有奖励标签时，将策略更新限制在该子集上会导致其余轨迹无法用于策略优化。半监督学习可以将标签从有标签样本传播到无标签样本，但现有方法要么使用固定的相似度权重来扩散标签，要么将每个样本独立处理，忽略了查询、思考过程与答案之间的关联。我们提出MemReward，一种基于图的经验记忆方法，可在在线策略优化过程中将奖励传播到无标签轨迹。MemReward将初始LLM策略的查询及其轨迹（思考过程与最终答案）存储为异构图中的节点，并通过相似性边和结构边进行连接，同时在有标签轨迹上预热训练一个GNN，以在图上传播奖励……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MemReward，将查询、思考过程和答案作为异构图节点构建经验记忆，利用GNN将有限的奖励标签传播到无标签轨迹，从而在RL微调中充分利用全部采样轨迹优化LLM策略。
en_tdlr: MemReward builds a graph-based experience memory over queries, thinking processes, and answers, using a GNN to propagate limited reward labels to unlabeled rollouts for more effective RL fine-tuning of LLMs.
